title: Klammerdiagramm — hastyaśvarathaghoṣaḥ
desc: German-Indological bracket diagram of the four-member compound hasti-aśva-ratha-ghoṣaḥ with a FLAT dvandva block: coordinate members hasti+aśva+ratha share one band (node A — no internal head, dvandva is coordinate), then B = [A]+ghoṣaḥ, the head taken right-to-left — the din of elephants, horses and chariots. I/II часть spans omitted by choice. Unsandhied segmented members, full word form.
